constraints: Keep go.mod and go.sum consistent: after the change no package should still require github.com/discord/lilliput, directly or through a replace directive.
github.com/discord/lilliput names no replacement module; pick a maintained alternative or accept the risk, and record the decision.

steps.instructions: Replace the github.com/discord/lilliput requirement with a maintained alternative that fits how the project uses it, then run `go mod tidy`.
steps.title: Replace the deprecated module

steps.instructions: Update imports and calls of github.com/discord/lilliput in the reported files to the chosen alternative.
steps.title: Migrate imports and calls

verification.purpose: Build and test every package without the deprecated module.

verification.command: go mod tidy && git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum
verification.purpose: Confirm go.mod and go.sum are tidy after the replacement.

rules.summary: The latest github.com/discord/lilliput module declares: "discord/lilliput is unmaintained as of October 2026. There will be no further releases, including for security fixes. See https://github.com/discord/lilliput/issues/303"
rules.title: github.com/discord/lilliput is deprecated
